summary: Frontend smoke-tested 10 acceptance criteria of iteration 2 (ELUS filosofia ajustes). Mobile viewport 390x844. Login → Profile-type Completo → Presença. Verified public profile p1 hides ALL personal data behind dots+lock, no percentages anywhere, atmospheric radar, request flow with skills toggle, sent tab shows name not ID, profile tab without email, stats label 'Completo' (not 'C'). 10/10 acceptance criteria PASS. One minor i18n inconsistency found (English field labels on connected business profile).

issues: FIELD_LABELS missing entries for 'description', 'category', 'services', 'products' — these render as raw English keys uppercased: 'DESCRIPTION', 'CATEGORY', 'SERVICES'. Also affects locked-state labels on p1 (DESCRIPTION instead of 'Descrição'). Minor i18n polish; doesn't break philosophy rules.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported, falling back to JS-based animation'. Expected on web preview; harmless. Will use native driver on iOS/Android.

acceptance_criteria_results.1_public_profile_p1_only_photo_name_reso: PASS — Mariana Costa shows photo, name, 'Alta ressonância' tag. All 10 fields (description, city, profession, interests, skills, cv, whatsapp, email, instagram, linkedin) render as 14× '•' with lock icon. No bio/profession/email/% leaked.
acceptance_criteria_results.2_no_numeric_percentages_anywhere: PASS — radar, list, p1 profile, p4 profile, sent tab and profile tab regex-scanned for /\d{1,3}\s*%/ → 0 matches on every screen.
acceptance_criteria_results.3_textual_resonance_labels_in_list: PASS — 'Alta ressonância', 'Contexto compatível', 'Presença relevante' all rendered correctly per compatibility thresholds.
acceptance_criteria_results.4_request_field_skills_toggle: PASS — testID='request-field-skills' present and tappable on /request-access/[id].
acceptance_criteria_results.5_sent_tab_shows_real_name: PASS — Sent card shows 'Para: Estúdio Ático'. 'Para: p4' NOT present.
acceptance_criteria_results.6_profile_tab_no_email_public_area: PASS — No 'test@example.com' rendered. Header shows name 'test' + 'PERFIL COMPLETO' tag + 'Gratuito' plan badge only.
acceptance_criteria_results.7_stats_card_completo_not_C: PASS — third stat reads 'Completo' / label 'Presença'. No isolated 'C'.
acceptance_criteria_results.8_atmospheric_radar: PASS — radar-canvas renders particles + single breathing horizon + center halo + center dot. No 4 concentric rings. High-compat nodes (c>0.7) wrapped in soft halo View.
acceptance_criteria_results.9_full_request_flow: PASS — navigated /profile/p4 → 'Solicitar acesso' → toggled skills → 'Enviar solicitação' → returned to p4 profile → connected-banner visible.
acceptance_criteria_results.10_fields_unlock_after_accept: PASS — After auto-approve, p4 shows actual values (Estúdio de arquitetura residencial., Arquitetura, Projetos/Reformas, São Paulo). Dots disappeared.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add Portuguese labels for 'description', 'category', 'services', 'products', 'links' in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts FIELD_LABELS so locked-state and connected-state labels appear in PT (Descrição/Categoria/Serviços/Produtos/Links) instead of uppercased English keys.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.sendAccessRequest auto-adds toUserId to connections immediately (simulated auto-approve). Demo-correct but real app should wait for owner accept. Fine for this mock iteration.
profile/[id].tsx hides description for non-essential profiles via lock dots — matches philosophy rule #1.
Resonance labels duplicated in 2 files (profile/[id].tsx & (tabs)/index.tsx). Consider extracting to /src/utils/resonance.ts (DRY).
seed_data_creation: None. App uses MOCK_PROFILES in AppContext.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is mocked client-side; any email/password works via /login. AppContext state is in-memory: page.goto() resets it — always navigate via in-app taps. Bottom tab bar buttons aren't easily selectable by text (multi-line); use coordinate clicks at y≈818 with x={39,117,195,273,351} for the 5 tabs on 390px width. testIDs used here: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, profile-type-complete-card, presence-screen, radar-canvas, presence-item-{id}, public-profile-screen, field-{key}, request-access-button, request-field-{key}, send-request-button, connected-banner, requests-screen, tab-sent, profile-screen.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only minor i18n labels inconsistency reported.
